title: Work Journal suggestions: tick boxes, select all, and Accept or Reject all or only the ticked ones
story: The Suggestions box now has a tick box on every suggestion and a select-all box in its header. From two pending suggestions the header shows Accept all / Reject all, which become Accept N / Reject N while N are ticked; they act on the day shown only, and reject asks 'Reject N? Yes / No' in place first. Each suggestion's own Accept and Reject still work, locked only while a bulk action runs.

checks.criterion: Bulk buttons appear from two pending suggestions and their label follows the ticks
checks.steps: Enable the Work Journal and open today's page with three made-up suggestions pending. Tick one suggestion, then tick all with the header box.
checks.expected: Every suggestion has a tick box and the header a select-all box; the header reads Accept all / Reject all, then Accept 1 / Reject 1, then Accept 3 / Reject 3; with one suggestion there is a tick box but no bulk buttons.

checks.criterion: Accept N adds N cards in list order
checks.steps: Tick the third and then the first suggestion, then press Accept 2.
checks.expected: Two cards at the end of the page in list order (first, then third); the middle suggestion stays.

checks.criterion: Reject N asks once and rejects N
checks.steps: Tick two suggestions and press Reject 2; press No; press Reject 2 again and press Yes.
checks.expected: 'Reject 2? Yes / No' in the header; No keeps everything and its ticks; Yes removes both and the page does not change.

checks.criterion: New suggestions arrive unticked, a rewritten one loses its tick, switching day clears ticks
checks.steps: Tick one suggestion and press run now so a new one arrives. Tick all and let a run rewrite one summary. Go to another day and back.
checks.expected: The old tick stays and the new one is unticked; the rewritten one is unticked; after the day change nothing is ticked.

checks.criterion: One failure leaves the rest done and the failed one ticked with its error
checks.steps: Have an update suggestion for a card plus two new suggestions. Edit that card by hand, then press Accept all.
checks.expected: The two new cards are added; the update stays ticked and the error reads '1 suggestion was not accepted and stays ticked.' followed by the card-changed message.
